rejected_rule.statement: In an action for a declaration of title, the plaintiff should describe his main land by reference to physical metes and bounds or by reference to a sufficient sketch, map or plan.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: Therefore in an action for a declaration of title, the claim is made for the main land. Therefore in an action for a declaration of title, „the specific portion of land‟ discussed in Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code is the land for which the plaintiff seeks a declaration of title.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 41 of the Civil Procedure Code
